semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides specialized lamps for semiconductor manufacturing processes, including photolithography and inspection.
summary: Japan Yuwa Techno specializes in high-output, high-efficiency ultraviolet irradiation lamps tailored for semiconductor manufacturing. Their products are designed to enhance production efficiency while minimizing environmental impact, making them suitable for applications like photolithography and adhesive curing.
capabilities: Environmental compliance with the Minamata Convention
